title: Microburst sampling harness and deterministic SLA verifier for Dedicated capacity
creator: Priya Patel
description: Goal: Build a deterministic load-testing harness and verification playbook that measures Dedicated capacity behavior for short-lived microbursts and sustained throughput. This ticket delivers: 1) a microburst sampling driver that can generate controlled high-concurrency spikes across tenant slices while preserving realistic request distributions, 2) deterministic SLA verifier that evaluates throughput guarantees against SLOs (throughput floor, 99th/95th latency percentiles, KV cache cold/hot scenarios), 3) a customer-facing onboarding checklist and acceptance test matrix for Dedicated customers to validate capacity claims, and 4) a reproducible artifact set (repo, infra IaC, dashboards, and runbooks) for handoffs to Solutions and Support.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can reproduce microburst scenarios with configurable spike width (5ms–10s), magnitude, and inter-arrival distribution via a single CLI invocation

Deterministic verifier runs a 3-day stress profile that includes cold-starts, cache-priming, and tenant-mix and produces a machine-readable report with throughput, p50/p95/p99 latencies, and tail-runs summary
Validation run exercises autoscaler control plane: verify scale-up latency <= configured policy (e.g., 90s for conservative policy) and scale-down hysteresis behavior matches policy settings
Customer acceptance playbook maps 6 canonical customer scenarios to harness profiles and includes pass/fail criteria and remediation steps
Artifacts (GitHub repo, Confluence PRD, dashboards) are linked and a demo run recorded and uploaded to the onboarding workspace
